_description: Pitch attraction rules from PlaybackService.ts and AnalysisService.ts. These automatic pitch adjustments apply during playback when not overridden by accidentals or explicit ignoreAttractions flags.

zo.description: When the melody descends after ZoHigh, ZoHigh is flattened by defaultAttractionZoMoria. This only applies in Diatonic, Kliton, or Zygos scales, and not when permanentEnharmonicZo is active.
zo.condition: virtualNote === ZoHigh AND scale is Diatonic/Kliton/Zygos AND useDefaultAttractionZo is true AND permanentEnharmonicZo is false
zo.pivotLogic: The system looks ahead from ZoHigh to determine if the melody descends. If the next different-pitched note is lower than ZoHigh, the zoFlatPivot is activated. If it ascends, the zoNaturalPivot is activated instead.
zo.note: A negative moria value means flattening (lowering pitch)

ke.description: When ZoHigh ascends (zoNaturalPivot is activated), Ke is attracted toward ZoHigh by being raised by defaultAttractionKeMoria.
ke.condition: virtualNote === Ke AND zoNaturalPivotActivated is true
ke.note: A positive moria value means sharpening (raising pitch). The zoNaturalPivot is cleared when the melody descends below Ke.

pivotMechanism.description: The pivot system determines which attraction to apply based on melodic direction after ZoHigh.

zoFlatPivot.activated: When next note after ZoHigh is lower than ZoHigh
zoFlatPivot.cleared: When current note is not ZoHigh

zoNaturalPivot.activated: When next note after ZoHigh is higher than ZoHigh
zoNaturalPivot.cleared: When current note descends below Ke

generalAlterations._description: General sharps and flats from fthora apply persistent accidentals to specific notes.

generalFlat.description: When a GeneralFlat fthora is in effect, every ZoHigh without an explicit accidental receives an automatic flat.

generalSharp.description: When a GeneralSharp fthora is in effect, every Vou without an explicit accidental receives an automatic sharp.

accidentalPersistence.description: When an accidental is applied to a note, it persists on that physical note until the melody moves to a different note. Subsequent visits to the same physical note inherit the accidental even without an explicit marking.

fields.lastAlterationMoria: The moria alteration amount from the last accidental
fields.lastAlterationNote: The physical ScaleNote that the accidental was applied to

accidentalValues._description: Maps accidental enum names to their moria alteration values (default non-chrysanthine).

chrysanthineAccidentals._description: In Chrysanthine mode, accidentals are proportional to the interval to the next note rather than fixed moria values.
chrysanthineAccidentals.note: The 8_crossbeam (3 crossbeam) accidentals are undefined in the Chrysanthine system.

legetosMode.description: Mode 4 Diatonic from Pa or Vou activates legetos mode, which uses the Legetos scale intervals instead of standard Diatonic.
legetosMode.condition: mode === 4 AND scale === Diatonic AND (scaleNote === Pa OR scaleNote === Vou)
legetosMode.effect: Uses Legetos scale intervals: [8, 10, 12, 12, 8, 10, 12] instead of Diatonic [12, 10, 8, 12, 12, 10, 8]

permanentEnharmonicZo.description: When set on a mode key, forces the enharmonic scale to be used regardless of the current scale setting. The enharmonic intervals are constructed dynamically based on the context.
permanentEnharmonicZo.effect: Overrides any scale to use the Enharmonic playback scale with intervals constructed for ZoHigh context: [diatonic..., 12, 12, 6, 12]
